scope: Extension of the frozen joint-grammar-v1 study. Fixed natural conjunctions, score-tail components and complete score-tail estimators are distinct estimands.

both.interpretation: The ratio conditions on denominator-event hits within the SAME fixed-budget sample; it is not a product of independent predicate probabilities.

block7.scope: Block6 model; rigorous component estimate and rigorous full-tail bounds, not a precise full-tail point estimate
block7.full_tail_interval_justification: P_full>=P_component. Component CP95 lower endpoint is a one-sided97.5% lower bound; original0/1m one-sided97.5% upper is1-.025^(1/1m). Bonferroni failure<=.025+.025 gives joint coverage>=95%.
block7.component_waiting_scope: Waiting for this subset event only; NOT a point estimate of full-tail waiting
block7.ratio_justification: P_full/P_natural>=P_component/P_natural. Divide component one-sided97.5% lower by natural one-sided97.5% upper; Bonferroni gives>=95% lower-bound coverage. This is not a point estimate of the full-tail ratio.

uniform.lower_bound_method: Markov inequality for the nonnegative unbiased mean of all eight fixed-budget SMC estimates: lower = .025 * mean.
uniform.upper_bound_method: One-sided 97.5% exact binomial bound from the original zero exceedances in one million IID controls.
uniform.coverage_scope: Pointwise for this model and frozen test, by Bonferroni. Not simultaneous over all models or conditional on a precision-gate outcome.

block6.lower_bound_method: Exact conditional W7 component: one-sided 97.5% scaled Clopper–Pearson lower endpoint.
block6.upper_bound_method: One-sided 97.5% exact binomial bound from the original zero exceedances in one million IID controls.
block6.coverage_scope: Pointwise for this model and frozen test, by Bonferroni. Not simultaneous over all models or conditional on a precision-gate outcome.

inversion_exact.upper_bound_method: One-sided 97.5% exact binomial bound from the original zero exceedances in one million IID controls.
inversion_exact.coverage_scope: Pointwise for this model and frozen test, by Bonferroni. Not simultaneous over all models or conditional on a precision-gate outcome.

uniform_natural.scope: Uniform labeled permutation null; fixed natural form(1,1), prime19, variant127, natural matrix view0. The full frozen score tail is a distinct larger event.
uniform_natural.primary_event: C15 & W3 & G3 & M15(view0), natural form/19, variant127

conditional_layer_steps.scope: Weighted nested-event ratio; covariance retained, approximate delta-method uncertainty
Weighted nested-event ratio; covariance retained, approximate delta-method uncertainty

uniform_natural.full_score_component_scope: C15W3(127) intersect (G3 natural127 or G3 natural129) intersect frozen full score tail. No completeness claim outside this intersection.
uniform_natural.weight_formula: M_F * product(H available edge counts) * product(completion available label counts) / (114! * 7!)
uniform_natural.uncertainty: Reported 95% intervals are approximate Monte Carlo intervals from iid importance-weight moments and a 16-worker Student t check. They are NOT exact binomial intervals or bounds on unenumerated hypothesis-selection bias. Waiting intervals quantify uncertainty in the expected waiting parameter 1/p, not realized waiting times.
